transcript.text: Good morning everyone. I want to address the chilled-water situation. As we all know, P-2 failed during the morning shift, and our production areas are without normal cooling right now. We've got a scheduled batch in the reactor suite today, and the packaging area and utilities workshop also rely on chilled water. Before we consider any temporary cooling connections, I want to make sure we go through our standard pre-work review covering process, maintenance, and EHS findings. I also want to remind everyone that we don't use temporary hose connections unless the installation, access, and isolation controls are properly recorded first. Let's discuss how we're going to handle this.
